title: Army and Joint Force Capture Sodari in North Kordofan
detail: The Sudanese army and allied Joint Force announced the capture of the town of Sodari in North Kordofan on September 26, 2026, after what it called fierce battles that inflicted heavy losses on the RSF, extending the westward campaign launched in late July. The RSF retained other parts of Sodari locality. Reports cited by Sudans Post said about 17 prisoners of war were killed during the operation; this is unverified.
